title: Starter plan overview
text: The Starter plan is designed for freelancers who invoice a handful of clients. Plans at this level add late payment reminders, receipt scanning, timesheets. Every plan includes unlimited clients and invoices.

title: API rate limits on the Starter plan
text: The API rate limit on the Starter plan is 60 requests per minute. Upgrading to Team changes this to 300 requests per minute. Requests above the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Limits are counted per workspace rather than per API token.

title: File storage on the Starter plan
text: Owners receive an email when usage passes 90 percent of the allowance. Receipts, attachments and exported reports all count toward storage. The file storage allowance on the Starter plan is 2 GB per workspace. Upgrading to Team changes this to 100 GB per workspace.

title: Audit log retention on the Starter plan
text: Older entries are deleted automatically once they pass the retention period. Audit log retention on the Starter plan is 7 days. The audit log records sign-ins, permission changes and invoice edits. Upgrading to Team changes this to 90 days.

title: Seat limits on the Starter plan
text: Deactivated members free their seat at the start of the next billing period. Upgrading to Team changes this to 25. Guests invited to the client portal do not use a seat. The maximum number of seats on the Starter plan is 3.

title: Support response times on the Starter plan
text: Upgrading to Team changes this to 24 hours. The first-response target for support tickets on the Starter plan is 72 hours. Tickets are answered in English, German and Spanish. Urgent outages should be reported through the in-app status banner.

title: Pricing on the Starter plan
text: The list price on the Starter plan is free for up to 3 seats. Upgrading to Team changes this to 12 dollars per seat per month. Prices exclude sales tax and VAT. Annual billing applies a 15 percent discount to the monthly list price.

title: Team plan overview
text: The Team plan is designed for small agencies that track time across projects. Every plan includes unlimited clients and invoices. Plans at this level add recurring invoices, multi-currency invoicing, mileage tracking.

title: API rate limits on the Team plan
text: Limits are counted per workspace rather than per API token. Requests above the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Upgrading to Business changes this to 1200 requests per minute. The API rate limit on the Team plan is 300 requests per minute.

title: File storage on the Team plan
text: The file storage allowance on the Team plan is 100 GB per workspace. Owners receive an email when usage passes 90 percent of the allowance. Upgrading to Business changes this to 1 TB per workspace. Receipts, attachments and exported reports all count toward storage.

title: Audit log retention on the Team plan
text: Older entries are deleted automatically once they pass the retention period. The audit log records sign-ins, permission changes and invoice edits. Audit log retention on the Team plan is 90 days. Upgrading to Business changes this to 1 year.

title: Seat limits on the Team plan
text: The maximum number of seats on the Team plan is 25. Upgrading to Business changes this to 250. Guests invited to the client portal do not use a seat. Deactivated members free their seat at the start of the next billing period.

title: Support response times on the Team plan
text: Tickets are answered in English, German and Spanish. The first-response target for support tickets on the Team plan is 24 hours. Urgent outages should be reported through the in-app status banner. Upgrading to Business changes this to 4 business hours.

title: Pricing on the Team plan
text: Prices exclude sales tax and VAT. Upgrading to Business changes this to 29 dollars per seat per month. The list price on the Team plan is 12 dollars per seat per month. Annual billing applies a 15 percent discount to the monthly list price.

title: Business plan overview
text: Every plan includes unlimited clients and invoices. Plans at this level add approval workflows, SAML single sign-on, custom roles. The Business plan is designed for growing companies that need approvals and finance controls.

title: API rate limits on the Business plan
text: The API rate limit on the Business plan is 1200 requests per minute. Limits are counted per workspace rather than per API token. Requests above the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Upgrading to Enterprise changes this to 5000 requests per minute.

title: File storage on the Business plan
text: Owners receive an email when usage passes 90 percent of the allowance. Receipts, attachments and exported reports all count toward storage. Upgrading to Enterprise changes this to 10 TB per workspace. The file storage allowance on the Business plan is 1 TB per workspace.

title: Audit log retention on the Business plan
text: The audit log records sign-ins, permission changes and invoice edits. Older entries are deleted automatically once they pass the retention period. Audit log retention on the Business plan is 1 year. Upgrading to Enterprise changes this to 7 years.

title: Seat limits on the Business plan
text: Guests invited to the client portal do not use a seat. Upgrading to Enterprise changes this to unlimited. The maximum number of seats on the Business plan is 250. Deactivated members free their seat at the start of the next billing period.

title: Support response times on the Business plan
text: Upgrading to Enterprise changes this to 1 hour. The first-response target for support tickets on the Business plan is 4 business hours. Tickets are answered in English, German and Spanish. Urgent outages should be reported through the in-app status banner.

title: Pricing on the Business plan
text: The list price on the Business plan is 29 dollars per seat per month. Prices exclude sales tax and VAT. Annual billing applies a 15 percent discount to the monthly list price. Upgrading to Enterprise changes this to quoted per contract.

title: Enterprise plan overview
text: Plans at this level add SCIM provisioning, sandbox workspaces, IP allowlisting. Every plan includes unlimited clients and invoices. The Enterprise plan is designed for organisations with security, compliance and procurement requirements.

title: API rate limits on the Enterprise plan
text: Requests above the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. The API rate limit on the Enterprise plan is 5000 requests per minute. Limits are counted per workspace rather than per API token.

title: File storage on the Enterprise plan
text: Receipts, attachments and exported reports all count toward storage. The file storage allowance on the Enterprise plan is 10 TB per workspace. Owners receive an email when usage passes 90 percent of the allowance.

title: Audit log retention on the Enterprise plan
text: Audit log retention on the Enterprise plan is 7 years. Older entries are deleted automatically once they pass the retention period. The audit log records sign-ins, permission changes and invoice edits.

title: Seat limits on the Enterprise plan
text: The maximum number of seats on the Enterprise plan is unlimited. Guests invited to the client portal do not use a seat. Deactivated members free their seat at the start of the next billing period.

title: Support response times on the Enterprise plan
text: The first-response target for support tickets on the Enterprise plan is 1 hour. Tickets are answered in English, German and Spanish. Urgent outages should be reported through the in-app status banner.

title: Pricing on the Enterprise plan
text: Annual billing applies a 15 percent discount to the monthly list price. The list price on the Enterprise plan is quoted per contract. Prices exclude sales tax and VAT.

title: Setting up recurring invoices
text: Every change to this setting is recorded in the audit log. Workspace owners and admins can change this setting. The setting for recurring invoices is under Invoices > Recurring > New schedule. The shortest billing interval for a recurring schedule is one week.

title: Plan availability for recurring invoices
text: Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Invoices > Recurring > New schedule. Admins can request a 14-day trial of recurring invoices from the billing page. The minimum plan for recurring invoices is Team.

title: Setting up multi-currency invoicing
text: The setting for multi-currency invoicing is under Settings > Billing > Currencies. Every change to this setting is recorded in the audit log. The number of supported invoice currencies is 38. The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form.

title: Plan availability for multi-currency invoicing
text: Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Settings > Billing > Currencies. The minimum plan for multi-currency invoicing is Team. Admins can request a 14-day trial of multi-currency invoicing from the billing page.

title: Setting up late payment reminders
text: The maximum number of reminders per invoice is 5. Workspace owners and admins can change this setting. The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form. The setting for late payment reminders is under Invoices > Reminders.

title: Plan availability for late payment reminders
text: Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Invoices > Reminders. Admins can request a 14-day trial of late payment reminders from the billing page. The minimum plan for late payment reminders is Starter.

title: Setting up receipt scanning
text: Every change to this setting is recorded in the audit log. The largest receipt file accepted is 15 MB. The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form. The setting for receipt scanning is under Expenses > Scan receipt.

title: Plan availability for receipt scanning
text: The minimum plan for receipt scanning is Starter. Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Expenses > Scan receipt. Admins can request a 14-day trial of receipt scanning from the billing page.

title: Setting up mileage tracking
text: Workspace owners and admins can change this setting. Changes take effect immediately for every member of the workspace. The setting for mileage tracking is under Expenses > Mileage. The default mileage rate source is the IRS standard rate for the current year.

title: Plan availability for mileage tracking
text: Admins can request a 14-day trial of mileage tracking from the billing page. Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Expenses > Mileage. The minimum plan for mileage tracking is Team.

title: Setting up approval workflows
text: The setting for approval workflows is under Settings > Approvals > Workflows. The maximum number of approval steps is 6. The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form. Changes take effect immediately for every member of the workspace.

title: Plan availability for approval workflows
text: Admins can request a 14-day trial of approval workflows from the billing page. The minimum plan for approval workflows is Business. Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Settings > Approvals > Workflows.

title: Setting up timesheets
text: Every change to this setting is recorded in the audit log. The timesheet lock period is 14 days after the week ends. The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form. The setting for timesheets is under Time > Timesheets.

title: Plan availability for timesheets
text: Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Time > Timesheets. Admins can request a 14-day trial of timesheets from the billing page. The minimum plan for timesheets is Starter.

title: Setting up project budgets
text: The default budget alert threshold is 80 percent of the budget. The setting for project budgets is under Projects > Budget. The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form. Changes take effect immediately for every member of the workspace.

title: Plan availability for project budgets
text: The minimum plan for project budgets is Team. Admins can request a 14-day trial of project budgets from the billing page. Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Projects > Budget.

title: Setting up client portal
text: The setting for the client portal is under Clients > Portal settings. Changes take effect immediately for every member of the workspace. Workspace owners and admins can change this setting. The lifetime of a client portal link is 30 days.

title: Plan availability for client portal
text: Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Clients > Portal settings. Admins can request a 14-day trial of the client portal from the billing page. The minimum plan for the client portal is Team.

title: Setting up custom invoice templates
text: The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form. The setting for custom invoice templates is under Settings > Branding > Templates. The number of custom templates allowed is 10. Changes take effect immediately for every member of the workspace.

title: Plan availability for custom invoice templates
text: Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Settings > Branding > Templates. Admins can request a 14-day trial of custom invoice templates from the billing page. The minimum plan for custom invoice templates is Team.

title: Setting up SAML single sign-on
text: The supported identity provider protocol is SAML 2.0. The setting for SAML single sign-on is under Settings > Security > SAML SSO. Every change to this setting is recorded in the audit log. The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form.

title: Plan availability for SAML single sign-on
text: Admins can request a 14-day trial of SAML single sign-on from the billing page. The minimum plan for SAML single sign-on is Business. Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Settings > Security > SAML SSO.

title: Setting up SCIM provisioning
text: The setting for SCIM provisioning is under Settings > Security > SCIM. The lifetime of a SCIM token is 1 year. Changes take effect immediately for every member of the workspace. The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form.

title: Plan availability for SCIM provisioning
text: Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Settings > Security > SCIM. Admins can request a 14-day trial of SCIM provisioning from the billing page. The minimum plan for SCIM provisioning is Enterprise.

title: Setting up custom roles
text: The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form. The setting for custom roles is under Settings > Members > Roles. Workspace owners and admins can change this setting. The maximum number of custom roles is 20.

title: Plan availability for custom roles
text: The minimum plan for custom roles is Business. Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Settings > Members > Roles. Admins can request a 14-day trial of custom roles from the billing page.

title: Setting up purchase orders
text: The setting for purchase orders is under Expenses > Purchase orders. Workspace owners and admins can change this setting. The default purchase order number format is PO-YYYY-NNNN. Changes take effect immediately for every member of the workspace.

title: Plan availability for purchase orders
text: Admins can request a 14-day trial of purchase orders from the billing page. Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Expenses > Purchase orders. The minimum plan for purchase orders is Business.

title: Setting up data export
text: The setting for data export is under Settings > Data > Export. Every change to this setting is recorded in the audit log. Changes take effect immediately for every member of the workspace. The list of export formats is CSV, JSON and XLSX.

title: Plan availability for data export
text: The minimum plan for data export is Starter. Admins can request a 14-day trial of data export from the billing page. Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Settings > Data > Export.

title: Setting up scheduled reports
text: The most frequent report schedule is daily at 06:00 workspace time. The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form. The setting for scheduled reports is under Reports > Schedules. Workspace owners and admins can change this setting.

title: Plan availability for scheduled reports
text: Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Reports > Schedules. The minimum plan for scheduled reports is Team. Admins can request a 14-day trial of scheduled reports from the billing page.

title: Setting up tax rules
text: The maximum number of tax rates per line item is 3. The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form. Workspace owners and admins can change this setting. The setting for tax rules is under Settings > Taxes.

title: Plan availability for tax rules
text: Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Settings > Taxes. The minimum plan for tax rules is Starter. Admins can request a 14-day trial of tax rules from the billing page.

title: Setting up sandbox workspaces
text: The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form. Workspace owners and admins can change this setting. The setting for sandbox workspaces is under Settings > Developer > Sandbox. The sandbox data reset interval is every 30 days.

title: Plan availability for sandbox workspaces
text: Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Settings > Developer > Sandbox. Admins can request a 14-day trial of sandbox workspaces from the billing page. The minimum plan for sandbox workspaces is Enterprise.

title: Setting up webhooks

title: Plan availability for webhooks
text: Admins can request a 14-day trial of webhooks from the billing page. Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Settings > Developer > Webhooks. The minimum plan for webhooks is Team.

title: Setting up IP allowlisting
text: Every change to this setting is recorded in the audit log. The maximum number of allowlisted IP ranges is 100. The setting for IP allowlisting is under Settings > Security > IP allowlist. Workspace owners and admins can change this setting.

title: Plan availability for IP allowlisting
text: The minimum plan for IP allowlisting is Enterprise. Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Settings > Security > IP allowlist. Admins can request a 14-day trial of IP allowlisting from the billing page.

title: Setting up credit notes
text: The credit note numbering prefix is CN. The setting for credit notes is under Invoices > Credit notes. Every change to this setting is recorded in the audit log. Workspace owners and admins can change this setting.

title: Plan availability for credit notes
text: The minimum plan for credit notes is Starter. Admins can request a 14-day trial of credit notes from the billing page. Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Invoices > Credit notes.

title: Setting up retainers
text: The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form. Every change to this setting is recorded in the audit log. The minimum retainer term is one month. The setting for retainers is under Invoices > Retainers.

title: Plan availability for retainers
text: Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Invoices > Retainers. Admins can request a 14-day trial of retainers from the billing page. The minimum plan for retainers is Business.

title: Setting up bulk invoice import
text: The maximum number of rows per import file is 5000. The mobile apps show the same configuration in read-only form. The setting for bulk invoice import is under Invoices > Import. Workspace owners and admins can change this setting.

title: Plan availability for bulk invoice import
text: Admins can request a 14-day trial of bulk invoice import from the billing page. Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Invoices > Import. The minimum plan for bulk invoice import is Team.

title: Setting up time-off tracking
text: The accrual calculation period is each pay period. Every change to this setting is recorded in the audit log. The setting for time-off tracking is under Time > Time off. Changes take effect immediately for every member of the workspace.

title: Plan availability for time-off tracking
text: The minimum plan for time-off tracking is Business. Admins can request a 14-day trial of time-off tracking from the billing page. Workspaces on lower plans see an upgrade prompt when they open Time > Time off.

title: Connecting Slack
text: Connecting requires an account with admin rights in Slack. Slack appears in the messaging category of the marketplace. The Slack integration is set up under Settings > Integrations. The minimum plan for the Slack integration is Starter.

title: How the Slack sync works
text: A manual sync can be started from the integration page at any time. The Slack sync interval is within 1 minute. The objects synced with Slack are invoice-paid and approval-request notifications.

text: If the error persists, contact support with the request ID from the banner. The fix for error TH-42224 is to review the field mappings under Settings > Integrations > Asana > Mappings. Error TH-42224 is caused by a field mapping that Asana rejects.

title: Error TH-40325: Stripe permission denied
text: Error TH-40325 is caused by a connected Stripe account without admin permission. The fix for error TH-40325 is to reconnect Stripe using an account with admin rights. If the error persists, contact support with the request ID from the banner.

title: Error TH-42926: Jira rate limited
text: The fix for error TH-42926 is to wait 15 minutes and then retry the sync. If the error persists, contact support with the request ID from the banner. Error TH-42926 is caused by too many requests to Jira in a short period.

title: Error TH-42227: HubSpot rejected a field
text: The fix for error TH-42227 is to review the field mappings under Settings > Integrations > HubSpot > Mappings. Error TH-42227 is caused by a field mapping that HubSpot rejects. If the error persists, contact support with the request ID from the banner.

title: Error TH-42928: Outlook Calendar rate limited
text: If the error persists, contact support with the request ID from the banner. Error TH-42928 is caused by too many requests to Outlook Calendar in a short period. The fix for error TH-42928 is to wait 15 minutes and then retry the sync.

title: Error TH-42229: QuickBooks Online rejected a field
text: The fix for error TH-42229 is to review the field mappings under Settings > Integrations > QuickBooks Online > Mappings. If the error persists, contact support with the request ID from the banner. Error TH-42229 is caused by a field mapping that QuickBooks Online rejects.

title: Data residency
text: Customer data is stored in the region chosen at signup. Moving a workspace to another region requires a migration request to support. The available data regions are the United States, the European Union and Australia.

title: Free trial
text: The free trial length is 21 days. Trials include every Business feature. No payment card is needed to start a trial.

title: Deleting your account
text: The grace period after an account deletion request is 30 days. Data is purged from backups within 90 days of deletion. Owners can cancel the deletion from the confirmation email during this time.

title: Refund policy
text: Annual subscriptions are refundable within 30 days of purchase. Monthly subscriptions are not refunded for partial months.

title: Uptime commitment
text: Service credits are issued automatically when the commitment is missed. The uptime commitment for paid plans is 99.9 percent per calendar month.

title: Backups
text: Backups are encrypted and stored in a second availability zone. The backup frequency for workspace data is every 6 hours.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: The supported two-factor methods are authenticator apps and hardware security keys. Owners can require two-factor sign-in for all members. SMS codes are not supported.

title: Password requirements
text: Passwords found in known breach lists are rejected. The minimum password length is 12 characters.

title: Session timeout
text: The default idle session timeout is 12 hours. Business and Enterprise owners can shorten the timeout.

title: Mobile apps
text: Receipt scanning works offline and uploads when a connection returns. The mobile apps are available for iOS 16 or later and Android 11 or later.

title: Supported browsers
text: Internet Explorer is not supported. The supported browsers are the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge.

title: Subscription payment methods
text: Enterprise contracts can also be paid by wire transfer. The accepted payment methods for subscriptions are credit card and ACH bank transfer.

title: Data processing agreement
text: The data processing agreement is signed from Settings > Legal > DPA. The agreement incorporates the EU standard contractual clauses.

title: Sub-processors
text: The current sub-processor list is published in the Trust Center. The notice period for new sub-processors is 30 days.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
text: Press the question mark key to see every shortcut. The shortcut for creating a new invoice is N followed by I.

title: Invoice numbering
text: The default invoice number format is INV followed by a six-digit sequence. Numbering restarts only when an owner changes the prefix.
